query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS value_scenario_responses (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  userId INT NOT NULL,
  twinId INT NOT NULL,
  scenarioId VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  scenarioCategory VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  scenarioText TEXT NOT NULL,
  userResponse TEXT NOT NULL,
  analysisResult JSON,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS value_evaluations (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  targetUserId INT NOT NULL,
  targetTwinId INT NOT NULL,
  evaluatorTwinId INT NOT NULL,
  evaluatorUserId INT NOT NULL,
  scenarioResponseId INT,
  verdict ENUM('virtue', 'mine', 'neutral') NOT NULL,
  judgmentScores JSON,
  reason TEXT,
  confidence DECIMAL(5, 2),
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cumulative_waveforms (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  userId INT NOT NULL,
  twinId INT NOT NULL,
  totalVirtueCount INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  totalMineCount INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  totalNeutralCount INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  cumulativeJudgmentScores JSON,
  evaluatorBreakdown JSON,
  lastUpdated TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);
